instructions: SECTION 2 · You will hear a coordinator briefing volunteers at a community festival.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.prompt: More visitors are expected this year mainly because

options.text: the festival has a new location.

questions.explanation: 'partly because the weather forecast is good, but mainly because we've moved to the larger site'.
questions.trap: 'partly … but mainly' — the question asks for the MAIN reason.

questions.prompt: What is different about this year's festival?

options.text: It lasts for a whole weekend.
It is free for the first time.

questions.explanation: 'this time the theme is sustainability' — recycling, local food, energy saving.
'Please come to the volunteer tent, not the main entrance'.

questions.prompt: When they sign in, volunteers will receive

options.text: a T-shirt and a meal voucher.
a T-shirt and a water bottle.

questions.explanation: 'you'll be given a T-shirt … We'll also give you a voucher for a free lunch'.

groups.instructions: What does the coordinator say about each team? Choose FIVE answers from the list, A–G.
groups.strategy: Two options are extra. Each team is described in order; listen for the specific responsibility, not general words that appear in several descriptions.

options.text: will not be in sole charge of young people
will work only in the morning
aim to correct a problem from the previous year

questions.explanation: Counting visitors 'because we need accurate figures for our funding applications'.
'last year a lot of recycling was rejected because it was contaminated'.
'You won't be responsible for supervising children on your own'.
'You'll be handling money … collect a cash box'.
